MC_ACRO_SUPEXPOY.shortDesc: Acro mode SuperExpo factor for Yaw

MC_AIRMODE.longDesc: The air-mode enables the mixer to increase the total thrust of the multirotor in order to keep attitude and rate control even at low and high throttle. This function should be disabled during tuning as it will help the controller to diverge if the closed-loop is unstable (i.e. the vehicle is not tuned yet). Enabling air-mode for yaw requires the use of an arming switch.

MC_BAT_SCALE_EN.longDesc: This compensates for voltage drop of the battery over time by attempting to normalize performance across the operating range of the battery. The copter should constantly behave as if it was fully charged with reduced max acceleration at lower battery percentages. i.e. if hover is at 0.5 throttle at 100% battery, it will still be 0.5 at 60% battery.

MC_MAN_TILT_TAU.longDesc: Setting this parameter to 0 disables the filter
MC_MAN_TILT_TAU.shortDesc: Manual tilt input filter time constant

MC_PITCHRATE_D.longDesc: Pitch rate differential gain. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again.

MC_PITCHRATE_I.longDesc: Pitch rate integral gain. Can be set to compensate static thrust difference or gravity center offset.

MC_PITCHRATE_K.longDesc: Global gain of the controller. This gain scales the P, I and D terms of the controller: output = MC_PITCHRATE_K * (MC_PITCHRATE_P * error + MC_PITCHRATE_I * error_integral + MC_PITCHRATE_D * error_derivative) Set MC_PITCHRATE_P=1 to implement a PID in the ideal form. Set MC_PITCHRATE_K=1 to implement a PID in the parallel form.

MC_PITCHRATE_MAX.longDesc: Limit for pitch rate in manual and auto modes (except acro). Has effect for large rotations in autonomous mode, to avoid large control output and mixer saturation. This is not only limited by the vehicle's properties, but also by the maximum measurement rate of the gyro.

MC_PITCHRATE_P.longDesc: Pitch rate proportional gain, i.e. control output for angular speed error 1 rad/s.

MC_PITCH_P.longDesc: Pitch proportional gain, i.e. desired angular speed in rad/s for error 1 rad.

MC_PR_INT_LIM.longDesc: Pitch rate integrator limit. Can be set to increase the amount of integrator available to counteract disturbances or reduced to improve settling time after large pitch moment trim changes.

MC_ROLLRATE_D.longDesc: Roll rate differential gain. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again.

MC_ROLLRATE_I.longDesc: Roll rate integral gain. Can be set to compensate static thrust difference or gravity center offset.

MC_ROLLRATE_K.longDesc: Global gain of the controller. This gain scales the P, I and D terms of the controller: output = MC_ROLLRATE_K * (MC_ROLLRATE_P * error + MC_ROLLRATE_I * error_integral + MC_ROLLRATE_D * error_derivative) Set MC_ROLLRATE_P=1 to implement a PID in the ideal form. Set MC_ROLLRATE_K=1 to implement a PID in the parallel form.

MC_ROLLRATE_MAX.longDesc: Limit for roll rate in manual and auto modes (except acro). Has effect for large rotations in autonomous mode, to avoid large control output and mixer saturation. This is not only limited by the vehicle's properties, but also by the maximum measurement rate of the gyro.

MC_ROLLRATE_P.longDesc: Roll rate proportional gain, i.e. control output for angular speed error 1 rad/s.

MC_ROLL_P.longDesc: Roll proportional gain, i.e. desired angular speed in rad/s for error 1 rad.

MC_RR_INT_LIM.longDesc: Roll rate integrator limit. Can be set to increase the amount of integrator available to counteract disturbances or reduced to improve settling time after large roll moment trim changes.

MC_YAWRATE_D.longDesc: Yaw rate differential gain. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again.

MC_YAWRATE_I.longDesc: Yaw rate integral gain. Can be set to compensate static thrust difference or gravity center offset.

MC_YAWRATE_K.longDesc: Global gain of the controller. This gain scales the P, I and D terms of the controller: output = MC_YAWRATE_K * (MC_YAWRATE_P * error + MC_YAWRATE_I * error_integral + MC_YAWRATE_D * error_derivative) Set MC_YAWRATE_P=1 to implement a PID in the ideal form. Set MC_YAWRATE_K=1 to implement a PID in the parallel form.

MC_YAWRATE_P.longDesc: Yaw rate proportional gain, i.e. control output for angular speed error 1 rad/s.

MC_YAW_P.longDesc: Yaw proportional gain, i.e. desired angular speed in rad/s for error 1 rad.

MC_YAW_WEIGHT.longDesc: A fraction [0,1] deprioritizing yaw compared to roll and pitch in non-linear attitude control. Deprioritizing yaw is necessary because multicopters have much less control authority in yaw compared to the other axes and it makes sense because yaw is not critical for stable hovering or 3D navigation. For yaw control tuning use MC_YAW_P. This ratio has no inpact on the yaw gain.

MC_YR_INT_LIM.longDesc: Yaw rate integrator limit. Can be set to increase the amount of integrator available to counteract disturbances or reduced to improve settling time after large yaw moment trim changes.

MIS_DIST_1WP.longDesc: Failsafe check to prevent running mission stored from previous flight at a new takeoff location. Set a value of zero or less to disable. The mission will not be started if the current waypoint is more distant than MIS_DIS_1WP from the home position.
MIS_DIST_1WP.shortDesc: Maximal horizontal distance from home to first waypoint

MIS_DIST_WPS.longDesc: Failsafe check to prevent running missions which are way too big. Set a value of zero or less to disable. The mission will not be started if any distance between two subsequent waypoints is greater than MIS_DIST_WPS.

MIS_LTRMIN_ALT.longDesc: This is the minimum altitude the system will always obey. The intent is to stay out of ground effect. set to -1, if there shouldn't be a minimum loiter altitude

MIS_MNT_YAW_CTL.longDesc: If enabled, yaw commands will be sent to the mount and the vehicle will follow its heading towards the flight direction. If disabled, the vehicle will yaw towards the ROI.
MIS_MNT_YAW_CTL.shortDesc: Enable yaw control of the mount. (Only affects multicopters and ROI mission items)

MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT.longDesc: This is the minimum altitude the system will take off to.

MIS_TAKEOFF_REQ.longDesc: If set, the mission feasibility checker will check for a takeoff waypoint on the mission.

MIS_YAW_ERR.shortDesc: Max yaw error in degrees needed for waypoint heading acceptance

MIS_YAW_TMT.longDesc: If set > 0 it will ignore the target heading for normal waypoint acceptance. If the waypoint forces the heading the timeout will matter. For example on VTOL forwards transition. Mainly useful for VTOLs that have less yaw authority and might not reach target yaw in wind. Disabled by default.
MIS_YAW_TMT.shortDesc: Time in seconds we wait on reaching target heading at a waypoint if it is forced

MNT_DO_STAB.longDesc: Set to true for servo gimbal, false for passthrough. This is required for a gimbal which is not capable of stabilizing itself and relies on the IMU's attitude estimation.

MNT_MAN_PITCH.shortDesc: Auxiliary channel to control pitch (in AUX input or manual mode)

MNT_MAN_ROLL.shortDesc: Auxiliary channel to control roll (in AUX input or manual mode)

MNT_MAN_YAW.shortDesc: Auxiliary channel to control yaw (in AUX input or manual mode)

MNT_MAV_COMPID.longDesc: If MNT_MODE_OUT is MAVLink protocol v2, mount configure/control commands will be sent with this component ID.
MNT_MAV_COMPID.shortDesc: Mavlink Component ID of the mount

MNT_MAV_SYSID.longDesc: If MNT_MODE_OUT is MAVLink gimbal protocol v1, mount configure/control commands will be sent with this target ID.
MNT_MAV_SYSID.shortDesc: Mavlink System ID of the mount

MNT_MODE_IN.longDesc: RC uses the AUX input channels (see MNT_MAN_* parameters), MAVLINK_ROI uses the MAV_CMD_DO_SET_ROI Mavlink message, and MAVLINK_DO_MOUNT the MAV_CMD_DO_MOUNT_CONFIGURE and MAV_CMD_DO_MOUNT_CONTROL messages to control a mount.

MNT_MODE_OUT.longDesc: AUX uses the mixer output Control Group #2. MAVLINK uses the MAV_CMD_DO_MOUNT_CONFIGURE and MAV_CMD_DO_MOUNT_CONTROL MavLink messages to control a mount (set MNT_MAV_SYSID & MNT_MAV_COMPID)

MNT_OB_LOCK_MODE.longDesc: if required for the gimbal (only in AUX output mode)
MNT_OB_LOCK_MODE.shortDesc: Mixer value for selecting a locking mode

MNT_OB_NORM_MODE.longDesc: if required by the gimbal (only in AUX output mode)
MNT_OB_NORM_MODE.shortDesc: Mixer value for selecting normal mode

MNT_OFF_PITCH.shortDesc: Offset for pitch channel output in degrees

MNT_OFF_ROLL.shortDesc: Offset for roll channel output in degrees

MNT_OFF_YAW.shortDesc: Offset for yaw channel output in degrees

MNT_RANGE_PITCH.shortDesc: Range of pitch channel output in degrees (only in AUX output mode)

MNT_RANGE_ROLL.shortDesc: Range of roll channel output in degrees (only in AUX output mode)

MNT_RANGE_YAW.shortDesc: Range of yaw channel output in degrees (only in AUX output mode)

MNT_RATE_PITCH.longDesc: Full stick input [-1..1] translats to [-pitch rate..pitch rate].
MNT_RATE_PITCH.shortDesc: Angular pitch rate for manual input in degrees/second

MNT_RATE_YAW.longDesc: Full stick input [-1..1] translats to [-yaw rate..yaw rate].
MNT_RATE_YAW.shortDesc: Angular yaw rate for manual input in degrees/second

MOT_ORDERING.longDesc: Determines the motor ordering. This can be used for example in combination with a 4-in-1 ESC that assumes a motor ordering which is different from PX4. ONLY supported for Quads. When changing this, make sure to test the motor response without props first.

MOT_POLE_COUNT.longDesc: Specify the number of magnetic poles of the motors. It is required to compute the RPM value from the eRPM returned with the ESC telemetry. Either get the number from the motor spec sheet or count the magnets on the bell of the motor (not the stator magnets). Typical motors for 5 inch props have 14 poles.
MOT_POLE_COUNT.shortDesc: Number of magnetic poles of the motors

MOT_SLEW_MAX.longDesc: Minimum time allowed for the motor input signal to pass through a range of 1000 PWM units. A value x means that the motor signal can only go from 1000 to 2000 PWM in maximum x seconds. Zero means that slew rate limiting is disabled.
MOT_SLEW_MAX.shortDesc: Minimum motor rise time (slew rate limit)

MPC_ACC_DOWN_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum vertical acceleration in velocity controlled modes down

MPC_ACC_HOR.longDesc: Note: In manual, this parameter is only used in MPC_POS_MODE 4.
MPC_ACC_HOR.shortDesc: Acceleration for auto and for manual

MPC_ACC_HOR_MAX.longDesc: MPC_POS_MODE 1 just deceleration 3 acceleration and deceleration 4 just acceleration
MPC_ACC_HOR_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum horizontal acceleration for auto mode and for manual mode

MPC_ACC_UP_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum vertical acceleration in velocity controlled modes upward

MPC_ALT_MODE.longDesc: Set to 0 to control height relative to the earth frame origin. This origin may move up and down in flight due to sensor drift. Set to 1 to control height relative to estimated distance to ground. The vehicle will move up and down with terrain height variation. Requires a distance to ground sensor. The height controller will revert to using height above origin if the distance to ground estimate becomes invalid as indicated by the local_position.distance_bottom_valid message being false. Set to 2 to control height relative to ground (requires a distance sensor) when stationary and relative to earth frame origin when moving horizontally. The speed threshold is controlled by the MPC_HOLD_MAX_XY parameter.

MPC_HOLD_DZ.shortDesc: Deadzone of sticks where position hold is enabled

MPC_HOLD_MAX_XY.shortDesc: Maximum horizontal velocity for which position hold is enabled (use 0 to disable check)

MPC_HOLD_MAX_Z.shortDesc: Maximum vertical velocity for which position hold is enabled (use 0 to disable check)

MPC_JERK_AUTO.longDesc: Limit the maximum jerk of the vehicle (how fast the acceleration can change). A lower value leads to smoother vehicle motions, but it also limits its agility.

MPC_JERK_MAX.longDesc: Limit the maximum jerk of the vehicle (how fast the acceleration can change). A lower value leads to smoother vehicle motions, but it also limits its agility (how fast it can change directions or break). Setting this to the maximum value essentially disables the limit. Note: This is only used when MPC_POS_MODE is set to a smoothing mode 3 or 4.

MPC_LAND_ALT1.longDesc: Below this altitude descending velocity gets limited to a value between "MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN" and "MPC_LAND_SPEED" Value needs to be higher than "MPC_LAND_ALT2"
MPC_LAND_ALT1.shortDesc: Altitude for 1. step of slow landing (descend)

MPC_LAND_ALT2.longDesc: Below this altitude descending velocity gets limited to "MPC_LAND_SPEED". Value needs to be lower than "MPC_LAND_ALT1"
MPC_LAND_ALT2.shortDesc: Altitude for 2. step of slow landing (landing)

MPC_LAND_RC_HELP.longDesc: When enabled, descent speed will be: stick full up - 0 stick centered - MPC_LAND_SPEED stick full down - 2 * MPC_LAND_SPEED
MPC_LAND_RC_HELP.shortDesc: Enable user assisted descent speed for autonomous land routine

MPC_MANTHR_MIN.longDesc: Minimum vertical thrust. It's recommended to set it > 0 to avoid free fall with zero thrust. With MC_AIRMODE set to 1, this can safely be set to 0.

MPC_MAN_TILT_MAX.shortDesc: Maximal tilt angle in manual or altitude mode

MPC_MAN_Y_TAU.longDesc: Setting this parameter to 0 disables the filter
MPC_MAN_Y_TAU.shortDesc: Manual yaw rate input filter time constant

MPC_POS_MODE.longDesc: The supported sub-modes are: 0 Simple position control where sticks map directly to velocity setpoints without smoothing. Useful for velocity control tuning. 3 Smooth position control with maximum acceleration and jerk limits based on jerk optimized trajectory generator (different algorithm than 1). 4 Smooth position control where sticks map to acceleration and there's a virtual brake drag

MPC_SPOOLUP_TIME.longDesc: For altitude controlled modes the time from arming the motors until a takeoff is possible gets forced to be at least MPC_SPOOLUP_TIME seconds to ensure the motors and propellers can sppol up and reach idle speed before getting commanded to spin faster. This delay is particularly useful for vehicles with slow motor spin-up e.g. because of large propellers.
MPC_SPOOLUP_TIME.shortDesc: Enforced delay between arming and takeoff

MPC_THR_CURVE.longDesc: This parameter defines how the throttle stick input is mapped to commanded thrust in Manual/Stabilized flight mode. In case the default is used ('Rescale to hover thrust'), the stick input is linearly rescaled, such that a centered stick corresponds to the hover throttle (see MPC_THR_HOVER). Select 'No Rescale' to directly map the stick 1:1 to the output. This can be useful in case the hover thrust is very low and the default would lead to too much distortion (e.g. if hover thrust is set to 20%, 80% of the upper thrust range is squeezed into the upper half of the stick range). Note: In case MPC_THR_HOVER is set to 50%, the modes 0 and 1 are the same.

MPC_THR_HOVER.longDesc: Vertical thrust required to hover. This value is mapped to center stick for manual throttle control. With this value set to the thrust required to hover, transition from manual to Altitude or Position mode while hovering will occur with the throttle stick near center, which is then interpreted as (near) zero demand for vertical speed. This parameter is also important for the landing detection to work correctly.

MPC_THR_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum thrust in auto thrust control

MPC_THR_MIN.longDesc: It's recommended to set it > 0 to avoid free fall with zero thrust.
MPC_THR_MIN.shortDesc: Minimum thrust in auto thrust control

MPC_TILTMAX_AIR.longDesc: Limits maximum tilt in AUTO and POSCTRL modes during flight.

MPC_TILTMAX_LND.longDesc: Limits maximum tilt angle on landing.

MPC_TKO_RAMP_T.longDesc: Increasing this value will make automatic and manual takeoff slower. If it's too slow the drone might scratch the ground and tip over. A time constant of 0 disables the ramp
MPC_TKO_RAMP_T.shortDesc: Position control smooth takeoff ramp time constant

MPC_USE_HTE.longDesc: Set false to use the fixed parameter MPC_THR_HOVER Set true to use the value computed by the hover thrust estimator

MPC_VELD_LP.shortDesc: Low pass filter cut freq. for numerical velocity derivative

MPC_VEL_MANUAL.longDesc: If velocity setpoint larger than MPC_XY_VEL_MAX is set, then the setpoint will be capped to MPC_XY_VEL_MAX
MPC_VEL_MANUAL.shortDesc: Maximum horizontal velocity setpoint for manual controlled mode

MPC_XY_CRUISE.longDesc: Horizontal velocity used when flying autonomously in e.g. Missions, RTL, Goto.

MPC_XY_ERR_MAX.longDesc: The integration speed of the trajectory setpoint is linearly reduced with the horizontal position tracking error. When the error is above this parameter, the integration of the trajectory is stopped to wait for the drone. This value can be adjusted depending on the tracking capabilities of the vehicle.
MPC_XY_ERR_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum horizontal error allowed by the trajectory generator

MPC_XY_MAN_EXPO.longDesc: The higher the value the less sensitivity the stick has around zero while still reaching the maximum value with full stick deflection. 0 Purely linear input curve (default) 1 Purely cubic input curve
MPC_XY_MAN_EXPO.shortDesc: Manual position control stick exponential curve sensitivity

MPC_XY_P.shortDesc: Proportional gain for horizontal position error

MPC_XY_TRAJ_P.shortDesc: Proportional gain for horizontal trajectory position error

MPC_XY_VEL_ALL.longDesc: If set to a value greater than zero, other parameters are automatically set (such as MPC_XY_VEL_MAX or MPC_VEL_MANUAL). If set to a negative value, the existing individual parameters are used.

MPC_XY_VEL_D_ACC.longDesc: defined as correction acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s^2 velocity derivative
MPC_XY_VEL_D_ACC.shortDesc: Differential gain for horizontal velocity error. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again

MPC_XY_VEL_I_ACC.longDesc: defined as correction acceleration in m/s^2 per m velocity integral Non-zero value allows to eliminate steady state errors in the presence of disturbances like wind.
MPC_XY_VEL_I_ACC.shortDesc: Integral gain for horizontal velocity error

MPC_XY_VEL_MAX.longDesc: Maximum horizontal velocity in AUTO mode. If higher speeds are commanded in a mission they will be capped to this velocity.

MPC_XY_VEL_P_ACC.longDesc: defined as correction acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s velocity error
MPC_XY_VEL_P_ACC.shortDesc: Proportional gain for horizontal velocity error

MPC_YAWRAUTO_MAX.longDesc: Limit the rate of change of the yaw setpoint in autonomous mode to avoid large control output and mixer saturation.
MPC_YAWRAUTO_MAX.shortDesc: Max yaw rate in auto mode

MPC_YAW_EXPO.longDesc: The higher the value the less sensitivity the stick has around zero while still reaching the maximum value with full stick deflection. 0 Purely linear input curve (default) 1 Purely cubic input curve
MPC_YAW_EXPO.shortDesc: Manual control stick yaw rotation exponential curve

MPC_Z_MAN_EXPO.longDesc: The higher the value the less sensitivity the stick has around zero while still reaching the maximum value with full stick deflection. 0 Purely linear input curve (default) 1 Purely cubic input curve
MPC_Z_MAN_EXPO.shortDesc: Manual control stick vertical exponential curve

MPC_Z_P.shortDesc: Proportional gain for vertical position error

MPC_Z_VEL_ALL.longDesc: If set to a value greater than zero, other parameters are automatically set (such as MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP or MPC_LAND_SPEED). If set to a negative value, the existing individual parameters are used.

MPC_Z_VEL_D_ACC.longDesc: defined as correction acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s^2 velocity derivative
MPC_Z_VEL_D_ACC.shortDesc: Differential gain for vertical velocity error

MPC_Z_VEL_I_ACC.longDesc: defined as correction acceleration in m/s^2 per m velocity integral Non zero value allows hovering thrust estimation on stabilized or autonomous takeoff.
MPC_Z_VEL_I_ACC.shortDesc: Integral gain for vertical velocity error

MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN.longDesc: Maximum vertical velocity in AUTO mode and endpoint for stabilized modes (ALTCTRL, POSCTRL).

MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP.longDesc: Maximum vertical velocity in AUTO mode and endpoint for stabilized modes (ALTCTRL, POSCTRL).

MPC_Z_VEL_P_ACC.longDesc: defined as correction acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s velocity error
MPC_Z_VEL_P_ACC.shortDesc: Proportional gain for vertical velocity error

NAV_ACC_RAD.longDesc: Default acceptance radius, overridden by acceptance radius of waypoint if set. For fixed wing the L1 turning distance is used for horizontal acceptance.

NAV_DLL_ACT.longDesc: The data link loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout, set by COM_DL_LOSS_T in seconds. Once the timeout occurs the selected action will be executed.
NAV_DLL_ACT.shortDesc: Set data link loss failsafe mode

NAV_FORCE_VT.shortDesc: Force VTOL mode takeoff and land

NAV_FT_DST.longDesc: The distance in meters to follow the target at

NAV_FT_FS.longDesc: The side to follow the target from (front right = 0, behind = 1, front = 2, front left = 3)

NAV_FT_RS.longDesc: lower numbers increase the responsiveness to changing long lat but also ignore less noise
NAV_FT_RS.shortDesc: Dynamic filtering algorithm responsiveness to target movement

NAV_FW_ALTL_RAD.longDesc: Altitude acceptance used for the last waypoint before a fixed-wing landing. This is usually smaller than the standard vertical acceptance because close to the ground higher accuracy is required.
NAV_FW_ALTL_RAD.shortDesc: FW Altitude Acceptance Radius before a landing

NAV_GPSF_LT.longDesc: The time in seconds the system should do open loop loiter and wait for GPS recovery before it goes into flight termination. Set to 0 to disable.

NAV_GPSF_P.longDesc: Pitch in degrees during the open loop loiter

NAV_GPSF_R.longDesc: Roll in degrees during the loiter

NAV_GPSF_TR.longDesc: Thrust value which is set during the open loop loiter

NAV_LOITER_RAD.longDesc: Default value of loiter radius for missions, Hold mode, Return mode, etc. (fixedwing only).

NAV_MIN_FT_HT.longDesc: The minimum height in meters relative to home for following a target

NAV_RCL_ACT.longDesc: The RC loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout, set by COM_RC_LOSS_T in seconds. If RC input checks have been disabled by setting the COM_RC_IN_MODE param it will not be triggered.

NAV_TRAFF_AVOID.longDesc: Enabling this will allow the system to respond to transponder data from e.g. ADSB transponders

NAV_TRAFF_A_RADM.longDesc: Defines the Radius where NAV TRAFFIC AVOID is Called For Manned Aviation
NAV_TRAFF_A_RADM.shortDesc: Set NAV TRAFFIC AVOID RADIUS MANNED

NAV_TRAFF_A_RADU.longDesc: Defines the Radius where NAV TRAFFIC AVOID is Called For Unmanned Aviation

OSD_ATXXXX_CFG.longDesc: Configure the ATXXXX OSD Chip (mounted on the OmnibusF4SD board) and select the transmission standard.

PCF8583_MAGNET.longDesc: Nmumber of signals per rotation of actuator

PCF8583_POOL.longDesc: Determines how often the sensor is read out.

PCF8583_RESET.longDesc: Internal device counter is reset to 0 when overun this value, counter is able to store upto 6 digits reset of counter takes some time - measurement with reset has worse accurancy. 0 means reset counter after every measurement.

PLD_BTOUT.longDesc: Time after which the landing target is considered lost without any new measurements.

PLD_FAPPR_ALT.longDesc: Allow final approach (without horizontal positioning) if losing landing target closer than this to the ground.

PLD_HACC_RAD.longDesc: Start descending if closer above landing target than this.

PLD_MAX_SRCH.longDesc: Maximum number of times to seach for the landing target if it is lost during the precision landing.

PLD_SRCH_ALT.longDesc: Altitude above home to which to climb when searching for the landing target.

PLD_SRCH_TOUT.longDesc: Time allowed to search for the landing target before falling back to normal landing.

PWM_AUX_DIS1.longDesc: This is the PWM pulse the autopilot is outputting if not armed. When set to -1 the value for PWM_AUX_DISARM will be used

PWM_AUX_DIS2.longDesc: This is the PWM pulse the autopilot is outputting if not armed. When set to -1 the value for PWM_AUX_DISARM will be used

PWM_AUX_DIS6.longDesc: This is the PWM pulse the autopilot is outputting if not armed. When set to -1 the value for PWM_AUX_DISARM will be used

PWM_AUX_DIS8.longDesc: This is the PWM pulse the autopilot is outputting if not armed. When set to -1 the value for PWM_AUX_DISARM will be used

PWM_AUX_DISARM.longDesc: This is the PWM pulse the autopilot is outputting if not armed. The main use of this parameter is to silence ESCs when they are disarmed.

PWM_AUX_FAIL1.longDesc: This is the PWM pulse the autopilot is outputting if in failsafe mode. When set to -1 the value is set automatically depending if the actuator is a motor (900us) or a servo (1500us)

PWM_AUX_FAIL2.longDesc: This is the PWM pulse the autopilot is outputting if in failsafe mode. When set to -1 the value is set automatically depending if the actuator is a motor (900us) or a servo (1500us)

PWM_AUX_FAIL5.longDesc: This is the PWM pulse the autopilot is outputting if in failsafe mode. When set to -1 the value is set automatically depending if the actuator is a motor (900us) or a servo (1500us)

PWM_AUX_FAIL8.longDesc: This is the PWM pulse the autopilot is outputting if in failsafe mode. When set to -1 the value is set automatically depending if the actuator is a motor (900us) or a servo (1500us)

PWM_AUX_MAX.longDesc: Set to 2000 for industry default or 2100 to increase servo travel.

PWM_AUX_MAX1.longDesc: This is the maximum PWM pulse the autopilot is allowed to output. When set to -1 the value for PWM_AUX_MAX will be used

PWM_AUX_MAX2.longDesc: This is the maximum PWM pulse the autopilot is allowed to output. When set to -1 the value for PWM_AUX_MAX will be used

PWM_AUX_MAX3.longDesc: This is the maximum PWM pulse the autopilot is allowed to output. When set to -1 the value for PWM_AUX_MAX will be used

PWM_AUX_MAX4.longDesc: This is the maximum PWM pulse the autopilot is allowed to output. When set to -1 the value for PWM_AUX_MAX will be used

PWM_AUX_MAX5.longDesc: This is the maximum PWM pulse the autopilot is allowed to output. When set to -1 the value for PWM_AUX_MAX will be used

PWM_AUX_MAX6.longDesc: This is the maximum PWM pulse the autopilot is allowed to output. When set to -1 the value for PWM_AUX_MAX will be used

PWM_AUX_MAX7.longDesc: This is the maximum PWM pulse the autopilot is allowed to output. When set to -1 the value for PWM_AUX_MAX will be used

PWM_AUX_MAX8.longDesc: This is the maximum PWM pulse the autopilot is allowed to output. When set to -1 the value for PWM_AUX_MAX will be used

PWM_AUX_MIN.longDesc: Set to 1000 for industry default or 900 to increase servo travel.

PWM_AUX_MIN1.longDesc: This is the minimum PWM pulse the autopilot is allowed to output. When set to -1 the value for PWM_AUX_MIN will be used

RC_CHAN_CNT.longDesc: This parameter is used by Ground Station software to save the number of channels which were used during RC calibration. It is only meant for ground station use.

RC_FAILS_THR.longDesc: Set to a value slightly above the PWM value assumed by throttle in a failsafe event, but ensure it is below the PWM value assumed by throttle during normal operation. Use RC_MAP_FAILSAFE to specify which channel is used to check. Note: The default value of 0 is below the epxed range and hence disables the feature.

RC_GEAR_TH.longDesc: 0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits 0 : min 1 : max sign indicates polarity of comparison positive : true when channel>th negative : true when channel<th

RC_KILLSWITCH_TH.longDesc: 0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits 0 : min 1 : max sign indicates polarity of comparison positive : true when channel>th negative : true when channel<th

RC_MAN_TH.longDesc: 0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits 0 : min 1 : max sign indicates polarity of comparison positive : true when channel>th negative : true when channel<th

RC_MAP_ARM_SW.longDesc: Use it to arm/disarm via switch instead of default throttle stick. If this is assigned, arming and disarming via stick is disabled.

RC_MAP_FAILSAFE.longDesc: Configures which channel is used by the receiver to indicate the signal was lost. Futaba receivers do report that way. If 0, whichever channel is mapped to throttle is used otherwise the value indicates the specific RC channel to use Use RC_FAILS_THR to set the threshold indicating lost signal. By default it's below the expected range and hence diabled.

RC_MAP_FLTMODE.longDesc: If this parameter is non-zero, flight modes are only selected by this channel and are assigned to six slots.

RC_MAP_MODE_SW.longDesc: This is the main flight mode selector. The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates which channel should be used for deciding about the main mode. A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_MAP_PARAM1.longDesc: Can be used for parameter tuning with the RC. This one is further referenced as the 1st parameter channel. Set to 0 to deactivate *

RC_MAP_PARAM2.longDesc: Can be used for parameter tuning with the RC. This one is further referenced as the 2nd parameter channel. Set to 0 to deactivate *

RC_MAP_PARAM3.longDesc: Can be used for parameter tuning with the RC. This one is further referenced as the 3th parameter channel. Set to 0 to deactivate *

RC_MAP_PITCH.longDesc: The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates which channel should be used for reading pitch inputs from. A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_MAP_ROLL.longDesc: The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates which channel should be used for reading roll inputs from. A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_MAP_THROTTLE.longDesc: The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates which channel should be used for reading throttle inputs from. A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_MAP_YAW.longDesc: The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates which channel should be used for reading yaw inputs from. A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_RSSI_PWM_CHAN.shortDesc: PWM input channel that provides RSSI

RTL_CONE_ANG.longDesc: Defines the half-angle of a cone centered around the destination position that affects the altitude at which the vehicle returns.
RTL_CONE_ANG.shortDesc: Half-angle of the return mode altitude cone

values.description: No cone, always climb to RTL_RETURN_ALT above destination.
Only climb to at least RTL_DESCEND_ALT above destination.

RTL_DESCEND_ALT.longDesc: Descend to this altitude (above destination position) after return, and wait for time defined in RTL_LAND_DELAY. Land (i.e. slowly descend) from this altitude if autolanding allowed.

RTL_FLT_TIME.longDesc: This is used to determine when the vehicle should be switched to RTL due to low battery. Note, particularly for multirotors this should reflect flight time at cruise speed, not while stationary
RTL_FLT_TIME.shortDesc: Maximum allowed RTL flight in minutes

RTL_LAND_DELAY.longDesc: Delay before landing (after initial descent) in Return mode. If set to -1 the system will not land but loiter at RTL_DESCEND_ALT.

RTL_LOITER_RAD.longDesc: Set the radius for loitering to a safe altitude for VTOL transition.

RTL_MIN_DIST.longDesc: The return altitude will be calculated based on RTL_CONE_ANG parameter. The yaw setpoint will switch to the one defined by corresponding waypoint.
RTL_MIN_DIST.shortDesc: Horizontal radius from return point within which special rules for return mode apply

RTL_PLD_MD.longDesc: Use precision landing when doing an RTL landing phase.

RTL_RETURN_ALT.longDesc: Default minimum altitude above destination (e.g. home, safe point, landing pattern) for return flight. This is affected by RTL_MIN_DIST and RTL_CONE_ANG.

RTL_TYPE.longDesc: Return mode destination and flight path (home location, rally point, mission landing pattern, reverse mission)

values.description: Return to closest safe point (home or rally point) via direct path.
Return to closest safe point other than home (mission landing pattern or rally point), via direct path. If no mission landing or rally points are defined return home via direct path.
Return to a planned mission landing, if available, using the mission path, else return to home via the reverse mission path. Do not consider rally points.
Return via direct path to closest destination: home, start of mission landing pattern or safe point. If the destination is a mission landing pattern, follow the pattern to land.

RTPS_CONFIG.longDesc: Configure on which serial port to run FastRTPS.

RTPS_MAV_CONFIG.longDesc: Configure on which serial port to run MAVLink + FastRTPS.

RWTO_AIRSPD_SCL.longDesc: Pitch up will be commanded when the following airspeed is reached: FW_AIRSPD_MIN * RWTO_AIRSPD_SCL
RWTO_AIRSPD_SCL.shortDesc: Min airspeed scaling factor for takeoff

RWTO_HDG.longDesc: 0: airframe heading, 1: heading towards takeoff waypoint
RWTO_HDG.shortDesc: Specifies which heading should be held during runnway takeoff

RWTO_MAX_PITCH.longDesc: Fixed-wing settings are used if set to 0. Note that there is also a minimum pitch of 10 degrees during takeoff, so this must be larger if set.

RWTO_MAX_ROLL.longDesc: Roll is limited during climbout to ensure enough lift and prevents aggressive navigation before we're on a safe height.

RWTO_MAX_THR.longDesc: Can be used to test taxi on runway

RWTO_NAV_ALT.longDesc: Until RWTO_NAV_ALT is reached the plane is held level and only rudder is used to keep the heading (see RWTO_HDG). This should be below FW_CLMBOUT_DIFF if FW_CLMBOUT_DIFF > 0.
RWTO_NAV_ALT.shortDesc: Altitude AGL at which we have enough ground clearance to allow some roll

RWTO_PSP.longDesc: A taildragger with steerable wheel might need to pitch up a little to keep its wheel on the ground before airspeed to takeoff is reached.
RWTO_PSP.shortDesc: Pitch setpoint during taxi / before takeoff airspeed is reached

RWTO_RAMP_TIME.shortDesc: Throttle ramp up time for runway takeoff

SDLOG_BOOT_BAT.longDesc: When enabled, logging will not start from boot if battery power is not detected (e.g. powered via USB on a test bench). This prevents extraneous flight logs from being created during bench testing. Note that this only applies to log-from-boot modes. This has no effect on arm-based modes.

SDLOG_DIRS_MAX.longDesc: If there are more log directories than this value, the system will delete the oldest directories during startup. In addition, the system will delete old logs if there is not enough free space left. The minimum amount is 300 MB. If this is set to 0, old directories will only be removed if the free space falls below the minimum. Note: this does not apply to mission log files.
SDLOG_DIRS_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum number of log directories to keep

SDLOG_MISSION.longDesc: If enabled, a small additional "mission" log file will be written to the SD card. The log contains just those messages that are useful for tasks like generating flight statistics and geotagging. The different modes can be used to further reduce the logged data (and thus the log file size). For example, choose geotagging mode to only log data required for geotagging. Note that the normal/full log is still created, and contains all the data in the mission log (and more).

SDLOG_MODE.longDesc: Determines when to start and stop logging. By default, logging is started when arming the system, and stopped when disarming.

SDLOG_PROFILE.longDesc: This integer bitmask controls the set and rates of logged topics. The default allows for general log analysis while keeping the log file size reasonably small. Enabling multiple sets leads to higher bandwidth requirements and larger log files. Set bits true to enable: 0 : Default set (used for general log analysis) 1 : Full rate estimator (EKF2) replay topics 2 : Topics for thermal calibration (high rate raw IMU and Baro sensor data) 3 : Topics for system identification (high rate actuator control and IMU data) 4 : Full rates for analysis of fast maneuvers (RC, attitude, rates and actuators) 5 : Debugging topics (debug_*.msg topics, for custom code) 6 : Topics for sensor comparison (low rate raw IMU, Baro and Magnetomer data) 7 : Topics for computer vision and collision avoidance 8 : Raw FIFO high-rate IMU (Gyro) 9 : Raw FIFO high-rate IMU (Accel)

SDLOG_UTC_OFFSET.longDesc: the difference in hours and minutes from Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) for a your place and date. for example, In case of South Korea(UTC+09:00), UTC offset is 540 min (9*60) refer to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_UTC_time_offsets

SDLOG_UUID.longDesc: If set to 1, add an ID to the log, which uniquely identifies the vehicle

SENS_BARO_RATE.longDesc: Barometric air data maximum publication rate. This is an upper bound, actual barometric data rate is still dependant on the sensor.

SENS_BOARD_ROT.longDesc: This parameter defines the rotation of the FMU board relative to the platform.

SENS_BOARD_X_OFF.longDesc: This parameter defines a rotational offset in degrees around the X (Roll) axis It allows the user to fine tune the board offset in the event of misalignment.

SENS_BOARD_Y_OFF.longDesc: This parameter defines a rotational offset in degrees around the Y (Pitch) axis. It allows the user to fine tune the board offset in the event of misalignment.

SENS_BOARD_Z_OFF.longDesc: This parameter defines a rotational offset in degrees around the Z (Yaw) axis. It allows the user to fine tune the board offset in the event of misalignment.

SENS_CM8JL65_R_0.longDesc: Distance Sensor Rotation as MAV_SENSOR_ORIENTATION enum

SENS_DPRES_ANSC.longDesc: Pick the appropriate scaling from the datasheet. this number defines the (linear) conversion from voltage to Pascal (pa). For the MPXV7002DP this is 1000. NOTE: If the sensor always registers zero, try switching the static and dynamic tubes.

SENS_EN_BATT.shortDesc: SMBUS Smart battery driver BQ40Z50 and BQ40Z80

SENS_EXT_I2C_PRB.longDesc: Probe for optional external I2C devices.

SENS_FLOW_MAXHGT.longDesc: This parameter defines the maximum distance from ground at which the optical flow sensor operates reliably. The height setpoint will be limited to be no greater than this value when the navigation system is completely reliant on optical flow data and the height above ground estimate is valid. The sensor may be usable above this height, but accuracy will progressively degrade.
SENS_FLOW_MAXHGT.shortDesc: Maximum height above ground when reliant on optical flow

SENS_FLOW_MAXR.longDesc: Optical flow data will not fused by the estimators if the magnitude of the flow rate exceeds this value and control loops will be instructed to limit ground speed such that the flow rate produced by movement over ground is less than 50% of this value.
SENS_FLOW_MAXR.shortDesc: Magnitude of maximum angular flow rate reliably measurable by the optical flow sensor

SENS_FLOW_MINHGT.longDesc: This parameter defines the minimum distance from ground at which the optical flow sensor operates reliably. The sensor may be usable below this height, but accuracy will progressively reduce to loss of focus.
SENS_FLOW_MINHGT.shortDesc: Minimum height above ground when reliant on optical flow

SENS_FLOW_ROT.longDesc: This parameter defines the yaw rotation of the PX4FLOW board relative to the vehicle body frame. Zero rotation is defined as X on flow board pointing towards front of vehicle. The recommneded installation default for the PX4FLOW board is with the Y axis forward (270 deg yaw).

SENS_GPS_MASK.longDesc: Set bits in the following positions to set which GPS accuracy metrics will be used to calculate the blending weight. Set to zero to disable and always used first GPS instance. 0 : Set to true to use speed accuracy 1 : Set to true to use horizontal position accuracy 2 : Set to true to use vertical position accuracy

SENS_GPS_PRIME.longDesc: When no blending is active, this defines the preferred GPS receiver instance. The GPS selection logic waits until the primary receiver is available to send data to the EKF even if a secondary instance is already available. The secondary instance is then only used if the primary one times out. To have an equal priority of all the instances, set this parameter to -1 and the best receiver will be used. This parameter has no effect if blending is active.

SENS_GPS_TAU.longDesc: Sets the longest time constant that will be applied to the calculation of GPS position and height offsets used to correct data from multiple GPS data for steady state position differences.

SENS_IMU_TEMP_P.shortDesc: IMU heater controller proportional gain value

SIH_BARO_OFFSET.longDesc: Absolute value superior to 10000 will disable barometer

SIH_DISTSNSR_OVR.longDesc: Absolute value superior to 10000 will disable distance sensor
SIH_DISTSNSR_OVR.shortDesc: if >= 0 the distance sensor measures will be overrided by this value

SIH_IXX.longDesc: The intertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix. It represents the difficulty of the vehicle to modify its angular rate.

SIH_IXY.longDesc: The intertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix. This value can be set to 0 for a quad symmetric about its center of mass.

SIH_IXZ.longDesc: The intertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix. This value can be set to 0 for a quad symmetric about its center of mass.

SIH_IYY.longDesc: The intertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix. It represents the difficulty of the vehicle to modify its angular rate.

SIH_IYZ.longDesc: The intertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix. This value can be set to 0 for a quad symmetric about its center of mass.

SIH_IZZ.longDesc: The intertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix. It represents the difficulty of the vehicle to modify its angular rate.

SIH_KDV.longDesc: Physical coefficient representing the friction with air particules. The greater this value, the slower the quad will move. Drag force function of velocity: D=-KDV*V. The maximum freefall velocity can be computed as V=10*MASS/KDV [m/s]

SIH_KDW.longDesc: Physical coefficient representing the friction with air particules during rotations. The greater this value, the slower the quad will rotate. Aerodynamic moment function of body rate: Ma=-KDW*W_B. This value can be set to 0 if unknown.

SIH_LOC_H0.longDesc: This value represents the Above Mean Sea Level (AMSL) altitude where the simulation begins. If using FlightGear as a visual animation, this value can be tweaked such that the vehicle lies on the ground at takeoff. LAT0, LON0, H0, MU_X, MU_Y, and MU_Z should ideally be consistent among each others to represent a physical ground location on Earth.

SIH_LOC_LAT0.longDesc: This value represents the North-South location on Earth where the simulation begins. A value of 45 deg should be written 450000000. LAT0, LON0, H0, MU_X, MU_Y, and MU_Z should ideally be consistent among each others to represent a physical ground location on Earth.

SIH_LOC_LON0.longDesc: This value represents the East-West location on Earth where the simulation begins. A value of 45 deg should be written 450000000. LAT0, LON0, H0, MU_X, MU_Y, and MU_Z should ideally be consistent among each others to represent a physical ground location on Earth.

SIH_LOC_MU_X.longDesc: This value represents the North magnetic field at the initial location. A magnetic field calculator can be found on the NOAA website Note, the values need to be converted from nano Tesla to Gauss LAT0, LON0, H0, MU_X, MU_Y, and MU_Z should ideally be consistent among each others to represent a physical ground location on Earth.
SIH_LOC_MU_X.shortDesc: North magnetic field at the initial location

SIH_LOC_MU_Y.longDesc: This value represents the East magnetic field at the initial location. A magnetic field calculator can be found on the NOAA website Note, the values need to be converted from nano Tesla to Gauss LAT0, LON0, H0, MU_X, MU_Y, and MU_Z should ideally be consistent among each others to represent a physical ground location on Earth.
SIH_LOC_MU_Y.shortDesc: East magnetic field at the initial location

SIH_LOC_MU_Z.longDesc: This value represents the Down magnetic field at the initial location. A magnetic field calculator can be found on the NOAA website Note, the values need to be converted from nano Tesla to Gauss LAT0, LON0, H0, MU_X, MU_Y, and MU_Z should ideally be consistent among each others to represent a physical ground location on Earth.
SIH_LOC_MU_Z.shortDesc: Down magnetic field at the initial location

SIH_L_PITCH.longDesc: This is the arm length generating the pitching moment This value can be measured with a ruler. This corresponds to half the distance between the front and rear motors.

SIH_L_ROLL.longDesc: This is the arm length generating the rolling moment This value can be measured with a ruler. This corresponds to half the distance between the left and right motors.

SIH_MAG_OFFSET_X.longDesc: Absolute value superior to 10000 will disable magnetometer

SIH_MAG_OFFSET_Y.longDesc: Absolute value superior to 10000 will disable magnetometer

SIH_MAG_OFFSET_Z.longDesc: Absolute value superior to 10000 will disable magnetometer

SIH_MASS.longDesc: This value can be measured by weighting the quad on a scale.

SIH_Q_MAX.longDesc: This is the maximum torque delivered by one propeller when the motor is running at full speed. This value is usually about few percent of the maximum thrust force.

SIH_T_MAX.longDesc: This is the maximum force delivered by one propeller when the motor is running at full speed. This value is usually about 5 times the mass of the quadrotor.

SIH_T_TAU.longDesc: the time taken for the thruster to step from 0 to 100% should be about 4 times tau

SIM_BAT_MIN_PCT.longDesc: Can be used to alter the battery level during SITL- or HITL-simulation on the fly. Particularly useful for testing different low-battery behaviour.

SYS_AUTOCONFIG.longDesc: Set to 1 to reset parameters on next system startup (setting defaults). Platform-specific values are used if available. RC* parameters are preserved.

SYS_AUTOSTART.longDesc: CHANGING THIS VALUE REQUIRES A RESTART. Defines the auto-start script used to bootstrap the system.

SYS_BL_UPDATE.longDesc: If enabled, update the bootloader on the next boot. WARNING: do not cut the power during an update process, otherwise you will have to recover using some alternative method (e.g. JTAG). Instructions: - Insert an SD card - Enable this parameter - Reboot the board (plug the power or send a reboot command) - Wait until the board comes back up (or at least 2 minutes) - If it does not come back, check the file bootlog.txt on the SD card

SYS_CAL_ACCEL.longDesc: 0 : Set to 0 to do nothing 1 : Set to 1 to start a calibration at next boot This parameter is reset to zero when the temperature calibration starts. default (0, no calibration)
SYS_CAL_ACCEL.shortDesc: Enable auto start of accelerometer thermal calibration at the next power up

SYS_CAL_BARO.longDesc: 0 : Set to 0 to do nothing 1 : Set to 1 to start a calibration at next boot This parameter is reset to zero when the temperature calibration starts. default (0, no calibration)
SYS_CAL_BARO.shortDesc: Enable auto start of barometer thermal calibration at the next power up

SYS_CAL_GYRO.longDesc: 0 : Set to 0 to do nothing 1 : Set to 1 to start a calibration at next boot This parameter is reset to zero when the temperature calibration starts. default (0, no calibration)
SYS_CAL_GYRO.shortDesc: Enable auto start of rate gyro thermal calibration at the next power up

SYS_CAL_TDEL.longDesc: A temperature increase greater than this value is required during calibration. Calibration will complete for each sensor when the temperature increase above the starting temeprature exceeds the value set by SYS_CAL_TDEL. If the temperature rise is insufficient, the calibration will continue indefinitely and the board will need to be repowered to exit.
SYS_CAL_TDEL.shortDesc: Required temperature rise during thermal calibration

SYS_CAL_TMAX.longDesc: Temperature calibration will not start if the temperature of any sensor is higher than the value set by SYS_CAL_TMAX.
SYS_CAL_TMAX.shortDesc: Maximum starting temperature for thermal calibration

SYS_CAL_TMIN.longDesc: Temperature calibration for each sensor will ignore data if the temperature is lower than the value set by SYS_CAL_TMIN.
SYS_CAL_TMIN.shortDesc: Minimum starting temperature for thermal calibration

SYS_FAC_CAL_MODE.longDesc: If enabled, future sensor calibrations will be stored to /fs/mtd_caldata. Note: this is only supported on boards with a separate calibration storage /fs/mtd_caldata.

SYS_FAILURE_EN.longDesc: If enabled allows MAVLink INJECT_FAILURE commands. WARNING: the failures can easily cause crashes and are to be used with caution!

SYS_HAS_BARO.longDesc: Disable this if the board has no barometer, such as some of the Omnibus F4 SD variants. If disabled, the preflight checks will not check for the presence of a barometer.
SYS_HAS_BARO.shortDesc: Control if the vehicle has a barometer

SYS_HAS_GPS.longDesc: Disable this if the system has no GPS. If disabled, the sensors hub will not process sensor_gps, and GPS will not be available for the rest of the system.
SYS_HAS_GPS.shortDesc: Control if the vehicle has a GPS

SYS_HAS_MAG.longDesc: Disable this if the board has no magnetometer, such as the Omnibus F4 SD. If disabled, the preflight checks will not check for the presence of a magnetometer.
SYS_HAS_MAG.shortDesc: Control if the vehicle has a magnetometer

SYS_HITL.longDesc: While enabled the system will boot in Hardware-In-The-Loop (HITL) or Simulation-In-Hardware (SIH) mode and not enable all sensors and checks. When disabled the same vehicle can be flown normally. Set to 'external HITL', if the system should perform as if it were a real vehicle (the only difference to a real system is then only the parameter value, which can be used for log analysis).
SYS_HITL.shortDesc: Enable HITL/SIH mode on next boot

SYS_MC_EST_GROUP.longDesc: Set the group of estimators used for multicopters and VTOLs

SYS_RESTART_TYPE.longDesc: Set by px4io to indicate type of restart

SYS_USE_IO.longDesc: Can be used to use a standard startup script but with a FMU only set-up. Set to 0 to force the FMU only set-up.

SYS_VEHICLE_RESP.longDesc: Changes the overall responsiveness of the vehicle. The higher the value, the faster the vehicle will react. If set to a value greater than zero, other parameters are automatically set (such as the acceleration or jerk limits). If set to a negative value, the existing individual parameters are used.

THR_MDL_FAC.longDesc: Parameter used to model the nonlinear relationship between motor control signal (e.g. PWM) and static thrust. The model is: rel_thrust = factor * rel_signal^2 + (1-factor) * rel_signal, where rel_thrust is the normalized thrust between 0 and 1, and rel_signal is the relative motor control signal between 0 and 1.
THR_MDL_FAC.shortDesc: Thrust to motor control signal model parameter

TRIG_ACT_TIME.longDesc: This parameter sets the time the trigger needs to pulled high or low.

TRIG_DISTANCE.longDesc: Sets the distance at which to trigger the camera.

TRIG_INTERVAL.longDesc: This parameter sets the time between two consecutive trigger events

TRIG_MIN_INTERVA.longDesc: This parameter sets the minimum time between two consecutive trigger events the specific camera setup is supporting.

TRIG_PINS.longDesc: Selects which FMU pin is used (range: AUX1-AUX8 on Pixhawk controllers with an I/O board, MAIN1-MAIN8 on controllers without an I/O board. The PWM interface takes two pins per camera, while relay triggers on every pin individually. Example: Value 56 would trigger on pins 5 and 6. For GPIO mode Pin 6 will be triggered followed by 5. With a value of 65 pin 5 will be triggered followed by 6. Pins may be non contiguous. I.E. 16 or 61. In GPIO mode the delay pin to pin is < .2 uS. Note: only with a value of 56 or 78 it is possible to use the lower pins for actuator outputs (e.g. ESC's).

TRIG_POLARITY.longDesc: This parameter sets the polarity of the trigger (0 = active low, 1 = active high )

TRIG_PWM_NEUTRAL.shortDesc: PWM neutral output on trigger pin

TRIM_PITCH.longDesc: The trim value is the actuator control value the system needs for straight and level flight. It can be calibrated by flying manually straight and level using the RC trims and copying them using the GCS.

TRIM_ROLL.longDesc: The trim value is the actuator control value the system needs for straight and level flight. It can be calibrated by flying manually straight and level using the RC trims and copying them using the GCS.

TRIM_YAW.longDesc: The trim value is the actuator control value the system needs for straight and level flight. It can be calibrated by flying manually straight and level using the RC trims and copying them using the GCS.

UAVCAN_BAT_MON.longDesc: This parameter defines that the system will select the battery monitor under the following conditions 0 - default battery monitor 1 - CUAV battery monitor

UAVCAN_ENABLE.longDesc: 0 - UAVCAN disabled. 1 - Enables support for UAVCAN sensors without dynamic node ID allocation and firmware update. 2 - Enables support for UAVCAN sensors with dynamic node ID allocation and firmware update. 3 - Enables support for UAVCAN sensors and actuators with dynamic node ID allocation and firmware update. Also sets the motor control outputs to UAVCAN.

UAVCAN_ESC_IDLT.shortDesc: UAVCAN ESC will spin at idle throttle when armed, even if the mixer outputs zero setpoints

UAVCAN_LGT_ANTCL.longDesc: This parameter defines the minimum condition under which the system will command the ANTI_COLLISION lights on 0 - Always off 1 - When autopilot is armed 2 - When autopilot is prearmed 3 - Always on

UAVCAN_LGT_LAND.longDesc: This parameter defines the minimum condition under which the system will command the LIGHT_ID_LANDING lights on 0 - Always off 1 - When autopilot is armed 2 - When autopilot is prearmed 3 - Always on

UAVCAN_LGT_NAV.longDesc: This parameter defines the minimum condition under which the system will command the RIGHT_OF_WAY lights on 0 - Always off 1 - When autopilot is armed 2 - When autopilot is prearmed 3 - Always on

UAVCAN_LGT_STROB.longDesc: This parameter defines the minimum condition under which the system will command the STROBE lights on 0 - Always off 1 - When autopilot is armed 2 - When autopilot is prearmed 3 - Always on

UAVCAN_NODE_ID.longDesc: Read the specs at http://uavcan.org to learn more about Node ID.

UAVCAN_RNG_MAX.longDesc: This parameter defines the maximum valid range for a rangefinder connected via UAVCAN.

UAVCAN_RNG_MIN.longDesc: This parameter defines the minimum valid range for a rangefinder connected via UAVCAN.

UAVCAN_V1_ID.longDesc: Read the specs at http://uavcan.org to learn more about Node ID.

VT_ARSP_BLEND.longDesc: Airspeed at which we can start blending both fw and mc controls. Set to 0 to disable.

VT_ARSP_TRANS.longDesc: Airspeed at which we can switch to fw mode

VT_B_DEC_FF.shortDesc: Backtransition deceleration setpoint to pitch feedforward gain

VT_B_DEC_I.shortDesc: Backtransition deceleration setpoint to pitch I gain

VT_B_DEC_MSS.longDesc: The approximate deceleration during a back transition in m/s/s Used to calculate back transition distance in mission mode. A lower value will make the VTOL transition further from the destination waypoint. For standard vtol and tiltrotors a controller is used to track this value during the transition.

VT_B_REV_DEL.longDesc: Set this to a value greater than 0 to give the motor time to spin down. unit s
VT_B_REV_DEL.shortDesc: Delay in seconds before applying back transition throttle

VT_B_REV_OUT.longDesc: Used for airbrakes or with ESCs that have reverse thrust enabled on a seperate channel Airbrakes need to be enables for your selected model/mixer
VT_B_REV_OUT.shortDesc: Output on airbrakes channel during back transition

VT_B_TRANS_DUR.longDesc: Time in seconds used for a back transition

VT_B_TRANS_RAMP.longDesc: This sets the duration during which the MC motors ramp up to the commanded thrust during the back transition stage.
VT_B_TRANS_RAMP.shortDesc: Back transition MC motor ramp up time

VT_B_TRANS_THR.longDesc: standard vtol: pusher tailsitter, tiltrotor: main throttle Note for standard vtol: For ESCs and mixers that support reverse thrust on low PWM values set this to a negative value to apply active breaking For ESCs that support thrust reversal with a control channel please set VT_B_REV_OUT and set this to a positive value to apply active breaking
VT_B_TRANS_THR.shortDesc: Target throttle value for the transition to hover flight

VT_DWN_PITCH_MAX.longDesc: When fixed-wing forward actuation is active (see VT_FW_TRHUST_EN). If demanded down pitch exceeds this limmit, the fixed-wing forward actuators are used instead.
VT_DWN_PITCH_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum allowed angle the vehicle is allowed to pitch down to generate forward force

VT_ELEV_MC_LOCK.longDesc: If set to 1 the elevons are locked in multicopter mode

VT_FWD_THRUST_EN.longDesc: This technique can be used to avoid the plane having to pitch down in order to move forward. This prevents large, negative lift values being created when facing strong winds. Fixed-wing forward actuators refers to puller/pusher (standard VTOL), or forward-tilt (tiltrotor VTOL). Only active if demaded down pitch is above VT_DWN_PITCH_MAX, and uses VT_FWD_THRUST_SC to get from demanded down pitch to fixed-wing actuation.
VT_FWD_THRUST_EN.shortDesc: Enable/disable usage of fixed-wing actuators in hover to generate forward force (instead of pitching down)

Enable FW forward actuation in hover in altitude, position and auto modes (except LANDING).
Enable FW forward actuation in hover in altitude, position and auto modes if above MPC_LAND_ALT1.
Enable FW forward actuation in hover in altitude, position and auto modes if above MPC_LAND_ALT2.
Enable FW forward actuation in hover in altitude, position and auto modes.
Enable FW forward actuation in hover in altitude, position and auto modes if above MPC_LAND_ALT1 (except LANDING).
Enable FW forward actuation in hover in altitude, position and auto modes if above MPC_LAND_ALT2 (except LANDING).

VT_FWD_THRUST_SC.longDesc: Scale applied to the demanded down-pitch to get the fixed-wing forward actuation in hover mode. Only active if demaded down pitch is above VT_DWN_PITCH_MAX. Enabled via VT_FWD_THRUST_EN.
VT_FWD_THRUST_SC.shortDesc: Fixed-wing actuator thrust scale for hover forward flight

VT_FW_ALT_ERR.longDesc: Maximum negative altitude error for fixed wing flight. If the altitude drops below this value below the altitude setpoint the vehicle will transition back to MC mode and enter failsafe RTL.

VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN.longDesc: Set to 1 to enable differential thrust in fixed-wing flight.

VT_FW_DIFTHR_SC.longDesc: This factor specifies how the yaw input gets mapped to differential thrust in forwards flight.

VT_FW_MIN_ALT.longDesc: Minimum altitude for fixed wing flight, when in fixed wing the altitude drops below this altitude the vehicle will transition back to MC mode and enter failsafe RTL

VT_FW_MOT_OFFID.shortDesc: The channel number of motors that must be turned off in fixed wing mode

VT_FW_PERM_STAB.longDesc: If set to one this parameter will cause permanent attitude stabilization in fw mode. This parameter has been introduced for pure convenience sake.

VT_FW_QC_P.longDesc: Maximum pitch angle before QuadChute engages Above this the vehicle will transition back to MC mode and enter failsafe RTL

VT_FW_QC_R.longDesc: Maximum roll angle before QuadChute engages Above this the vehicle will transition back to MC mode and enter failsafe RTL

VT_F_TRANS_DUR.longDesc: Time in seconds used for a transition

VT_F_TRANS_THR.longDesc: standard vtol: pusher tailsitter, tiltrotor: main throttle
VT_F_TRANS_THR.shortDesc: Target throttle value for the transition to fixed wing flight

VT_F_TR_OL_TM.longDesc: The duration of the front transition when there is no airspeed feedback available.
VT_F_TR_OL_TM.shortDesc: Airspeed less front transition time (open loop)

VT_IDLE_PWM_MC.shortDesc: Idle speed of VTOL when in multicopter mode

VT_MC_ON_FMU.longDesc: Set this parameter to true if the vehicle's hover motors are connected to the FMU (AUX) port. Not required for boards that only have a FMU, and no IO. Only applies for standard VTOL and tiltrotor.
VT_MC_ON_FMU.shortDesc: Enable the usage of AUX outputs for hover motors

VT_MOT_ID.shortDesc: The channel number of motors which provide lift during hover

VT_PSHER_RMP_DT.longDesc: Defines the time window during which the pusher throttle will be ramped up linearly to VT_F_TRANS_THR during a transition to fixed wing mode. Zero or negative values will produce an instant throttle rise to VT_F_TRANS_THR.

VT_TILT_FW.shortDesc: Position of tilt servo in fw mode

VT_TILT_MC.shortDesc: Position of tilt servo in mc mode

VT_TILT_SPINUP.longDesc: This specific tilt during spin-up is necessary for some systems whose motors otherwise don't spin-up freely.
VT_TILT_SPINUP.shortDesc: Tilt actuator control value commanded when disarmed and during the first second after arming

VT_TILT_TRANS.shortDesc: Position of tilt servo in transition mode

VT_TRANS_MIN_TM.longDesc: Minimum time in seconds for front transition.

VT_TRANS_P2_DUR.longDesc: Time in seconds it should take for the rotors to rotate forward completely from the point when the plane has picked up enough airspeed and is ready to go into fixed wind mode.

VT_TRANS_TIMEOUT.longDesc: Time in seconds after which transition will be cancelled. Disabled if set to 0.

WV_GAIN.longDesc: The desired gain to convert roll sp into yaw rate sp.

WV_ROLL_MIN.shortDesc: Minimum roll angle setpoint for weathervane controller to demand a yaw-rate

WV_YRATE_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum yawrate the weathervane controller is allowed to demand
